title: Add files with WS_DLL_PUBLIC to Doxygen
description:
Add @file markers for most files that
contain functions exported with
WS_DLL_PUBLIC so that Doxygen will
generate documentation for them.

notes.body: Never cared much for the name in the header of the file itself. Sometimes misnamed (looking at you wmem_multimap), sometimes forgotten when files are moved around/renamed. `\file` does not even require a name. Should we drop it?
I only added it for consistency, as many of the files already had the name. Happy to remove if you think that would be better.

added 5 commits
  • 8b9ac3f6...b031a2a4 - 4 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 5a00c164 - Add files with WS_DLL_PUBLIC to Doxygen
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5217/diffs?diff_id=285727271&start_sha=8b9ac3f6ac4008f22323003c1ca678654598cf8b)
No idea if it's 'better'. We should set some form of documentation policy first, which we can agree on and are willing to maintain, before implementing sweeping changes, IMHO.
@geraldcombs would you be able to take a look?

Is there a reason we wouldn't want Doxygen to to the work for us in this case? I'd vote for using bare "@file" commands everywhere if we can.

BTW, a bunch of Qt modules have a description instead of a filename ("@file Percent bar delegate.") which appear to be my fault. I'll work on fixing them.
I've updated the commit to remove filenames after the @file marker.

commits_data.title: Add files with WS_DLL_PUBLIC to Doxygen
commits_data.message:
Add files with WS_DLL_PUBLIC to Doxygen

Add @file markers for most files that
contain functions exported with
WS_DLL_PUBLIC so that Doxygen will
generate documentation for them.
